subject: Provisional burst lane pricing for BrightLane launch
messages:
From: Jill Carter <jill@brightlane.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: sales_ops@brightlane.com
Date: 2025-07-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ask — launch week burst & temporary uplift

Hi Priyom,

We're finalizing the rollout plan for our user-growth experiment and expect a 6–8 hour window of 6x normal traffic on 2025-08-05 (projected peak tokens attached). Can Redwood provision a short-term burst bucket or temporary quota increase to keep latency steady?

Key asks:
- Temporary QPS/headroom for 8 hours starting 08:00 PT on Aug 5
- Any one-off uplift pricing or credits you can extend for sprint launches
- How you handle overrun true-ups and invoice timing (we prefer monthly recon)

I've attached a short forecast (brightlane_traffic_forecast.xlsx) and highlighted the estimated incremental tokens. We have an existing committed discount (term in our contract) — curious if there's a way to layer a transient concession so this experiment doesn't blow up the month.

Thanks — can we get an answer by EOD today?

Jill
Jill Carter
Head of Product, BrightLane
From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: Jill Carter <jill@brightlane.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2025-07-27T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — launch week burst & temporary uplift

Hi Jill — thanks for the forecast and timeline. We can support a short-term uplift; below are two practical options we can offer immediately:

Option A — Provisional burst lane (recommended)
- Provision a dedicated burst allowance for 8 hours (token-based)
- Add-on fee: one-time 12% of estimated incremental consumption (covers priority capacity)
- Post-window: consumption is measured and true-up is applied against the monthly invoice; we can issue a provisional credit if actual peak is lower

Option B — Temporary rate-tier swap
- Temporarily elevate you to the next rate tier for the 8-hour window
- Add-on fee: incremental per-token at next tier (no separate priority fee)
- Standard monthly true-up applies

Negotiable concession: because you are an active committer, I can route a 15% concession on the add-on fee, subject to approvals (finance/legal).

Next steps I need from you:
- Confirm which option you prefer
- Sign-off on provisional MAP (I attached a draft)
- PO or email authorization to proceed

I'll loop Karhtik to check finance appetite for the 15% concession and timing for invoice flow.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2025-07-27T14:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — launch week burst & temporary uplift

Priyom / Laura —

Saw Jill's ask. Finance will approve a temporary concession but prefers a simple, auditable path. My suggested play:

- Approve Option A (provisional burst lane) with a capped uplift fee equal to 12% of the estimated incremental spend.
- Offer a 25% concession on that uplift fee (so customer pays 9% effective uplift) in exchange for a short note in the SOW that the uplift will be reconciled in the next monthly invoice.
- Require BrightLane to provide a PO or an email authorization prior to provisioning.
- Any actual overrun will be measured and billed on the normal monthly invoice; if usage is materially lower (>20% below forecast), we provide a one-time partial credit to smooth reconciliation.

Laura, please confirm routing for invoicing and whether we need a one-off amendment to their contract or if a signed MAP is sufficient.

Karthik Iyer
Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: Jill Carter <jill@brightlane.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2025-07-28T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — launch week burst & temporary uplift

Jill — thanks, good to confirm. Per internal approval (summary below) we can proceed with Option A and the concession:

Agreed plan (summary)
- Provision: temporary burst lane for 8 hours on 2025-08-05 starting 08:00 PT
- Pricing: uplift fee = 12% of estimated incremental tokens, 25% concession applied (effective uplift = 9%)
- Billing: usage will be measured and reconciled on the next monthly invoice; we will include the uplift charge on that invoice.
- Credit guardrail: if actual incremental usage is >20% below the forecast, we'll apply a partial credit to the uplift charge.
- Pre-req: please send a PO or a one-line email authorizing the uplift and attach the signed provisional MAP.

I've attached the provisional MAP (provisional_MAP_v1.pdf) that captures the limits and timing. Once we have your PO/email, we will schedule provisioning and send a confirmation.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/exec?envelopeId=0a1b2c3
Drive (forecast): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cForecast

If you'd like, I can provision a modest safety margin now and then scale it down after the first 2 hours if telemetry looks stable.

Thanks —
Priyom Das
